name: criv-obsidian-plugin
description: Obsidian companion plugin for criv vault state.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:plugin && npm run smoke:wasm
scripts.build:wasm: mise exec cargo:wasm-pack@0.15.0 -- wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../../.obsidian/plugins/criv/pkg ../../../crates/criv-wasm -- --locked
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.lint: oxlint src test scripts esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test scripts esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test scripts esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs
